children: Irenic Acquisition had no operating revenue in the quarter and reported net income from $2.35 million of trust-account investment interest, partly offset by $252,462 in general and administrative costs. The company says it will not generate operating revenue until after a business combination.
: The company continued identifying a target for a business combination and had not commenced operations.
: Investments held in the Trust Account totaled $256.4 million as of September 30, 2026.
: Cash was $983,528 and working capital was $828,826 as of September 30, 2026.
: The company has 24 months from the IPO closing to complete a business combination.
